messages:
Marta L: Heads-up: Product wants canonical URLs consolidated for launch. We're also landing a webinar page and need to lock schema + redirects so search doesn't drop traffic. Who can take the redirects spreadsheet?

Eli R: I can. Quick ask: do we keep old blog slugs as-is or map to topic hubs under /resources? I'd prefer hubs (better internal linking).

Diego P: Hubs make sense. Proposed mapping: /blog/* -> /resources/topic-hub/* and then 301. We'll preserve query params for UTM.

Nina K: Can we also add breadcrumb schema on hubs and the webinar page? That helps SERP context for topics like "inference cost" benchmarks.

Marta L: Yes. Checklist I'll run in the sync:
- Redirect CSV (old,new,type,keep_queries)
- Update rel=canonical on migrated pages to point to hub URL
- Regenerate sitemap.xml and ping Search Console
- JSON-LD: BreadcrumbList + Event + FAQ for webinar
- Internal link sweep: product docs -> hubs, old blog links -> new canonical
- GTM / conversions: ensure existing goal fires on new path
- Staging crawl: validate 200/301/404s, ensure no 302 chains

Eli R: Proposed redirect CSV sample row: `https://redwood.example.com/blog/2024/latency-vs-cost,https://redwood.example.com/resources/latency-cost-tradeoffs,301,keep_utms`

Diego P: Note on regex: the hosting platform supports named groups. Example rule for year-based slugs: `^/blog/(?P<year>\d{4})/(?P<slug>[-\w]+)/?$` -> `/resources/{slug}`. I'll attach tested regex in PR.

seo-bot: Automated check: run staging crawl after redirects deployed; flag if >5% of top-100 pages return 4xx or >1 redirect hop. Also run Lighthouse SEO and Accessibility quick check.

Nina K: Webinar schema draft (minimal):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Benchmarking LLM Inference","startDate":"2026-05-05T17:00:00Z","endDate":"2026-05-05T18:00:00Z","eventStatus":"https://schema.org/EventScheduled","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example.com/resources/webinar-llm-benchmarks"}}
```

Marta L: Add FAQ about "Will this content replace older posts?" and "How to get benchmarks/data". Put those in FAQ schema on the webinar landing.

Eli R: Internal linking plan: create contextual links from product pages (inference, pricing) to the hubs. Also update older posts to point to the hub via a short inline notice ("Updated: consolidated into ...").

Diego P: Redirects + canonical rules for trailing slash: canonicalize to without trailing slash. We'll normalize in nginx conf and in sitemap.

Nina K: For inbound lead routing: make sure webinar signups still populate HubSpot source and lead UTM. When the path changes, HubSpot form needs the new page id or data attributes. I'll coordinate with Ops.

Marta L: Owners: Eli = redirect CSV + PR, Diego = regex & staging tests, Nina = schema + GTM/HubSpot checks, me = sitemap + Search Console submit. We'll meet in 20 to confirm owners and timelines.

Eli R: I'll drop the CSV into /ops/redirects/ and open PR titled "SEO: blog -> resources redirects (hubs)". Ping me for regex edge cases.

Diego P: Will run an index coverage check post-deploy and post canonical update. If any high-traffic URL drops, we'll roll back that route and investigate.

Marta L: Great. Everyone, capture any content title/meta changes in the content tracker. Thanks :rocket:
